title: My camera tagged me as a stranger 📷
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 2:14 in the morning, my hallway camera sent me an alert: unknown person detected.

scenes.narration: At 2:14 in the morning, my hallway camera sent me an alert: unknown person detected.
I live alone. I was in bed. I opened the live feed with shaking hands.
The hallway was empty. Just the street light, and my front door at the far end.
Then I opened the clip history. Eleven clips. One every night. Always at 2:14. Always twenty seconds long.
In the first clip, a figure stood outside my door. In the second, it was inside, by the coats.
Each night, one step closer. The kitchen doorway. The bathroom. Last night, right outside my bedroom.
Every clip had a label under it. Recognized: owner. I did not understand. I am the owner.
Tonight's clip was already uploading. Twenty seconds. I pressed play.
It showed my bedroom from above. A figure standing by the bed. And a small label. Recognized: owner.
Then the app refreshed. A new alert. Unknown person detected. Location: bedroom. It meant me. I was the stranger.
So tell me. Do you hide, or confront the owner?
